source: A synthetic CI thread board: the shape of a real board the c46 check-in failed to fold (three goals that ride other goals' jobs or a duty), with the fields the fold reads.

duties.name: CI system
duties.goal: CI never makes an agent wait, and lands and promotes stay green. Every runner is online. 9 of 10 jobs start within 20 min on runner-a and 15 min on runner-b. Half of the verify runs end within 20 min. At least 80% of land and promote runs pass over 7 days. Half of the lands end within 45 min. The daily CI health run passes and is less than 26 h old.

duties.name: Git rules
duties.goal: Every release rule and probe rule holds every day. Only the release owner pushes the dev branch and starts the land and promote workflows. Nobody force-pushes. staging moves only through the land workflow, and main only through the promote workflow. Nobody re-runs a test run. One probe runs at a time. Each break names the session that made it.

duties.name: Repo design
duties.goal: The monorepo and GitHub Actions stay well designed. Code, not docs, enforces the release rule. There is one check suite, one CI lane per app, and no dead apps. The rules every agent loads stay short. Lands pass and happen often. Every week a review says whether we still do the right thing and starts a fix for each new problem.
